1: // Minimal Meteor Defense game
2: // Canvas with id "game" assumed in the HTML
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   // Simple sound system using Web Audio API
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
14:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
17:     oscillator.frequency.value = freq;
18:     oscillator.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     oscillator.start();
22:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   // Sound wrappers
25:   function shootSound() { playTone(600, 0.08); }
26:   function explosionSound() { playTone(200, 0.2); }
27:   function gameOverSound() { playTone(100, 0.5); }
28:   const width = canvas.width;
29:   const height = canvas.height;
30: 
31:   // Generate background stars
32:   const stars = [];
33:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
34:     stars.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * width,
36:       y: Math.random() * height,
37:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
38:     });
39:   }
40: 
41:   // Ship definition (triangle shape)
42:   const ship = {
43:     w: 40,
44:     h: 20,
45:     x: width / 2 - 20,
46:     y: height - 30,
47:     speed: 6,
48:     color: '#0f0',
49:     // precomputed shape points for drawing
50:     draw(ctx) {
51:       ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
52:       ctx.beginPath();
53:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h);
54:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y);
55:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
56:       ctx.closePath();
57:       ctx.fill();
58:     },
59:   };
60: 
61:   // Input handling
62:   const keys = {};
63:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
64:     keys[e.code] = true;
65:     if (e.code === 'Space') fire();
66:   });
67:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
68:   canvas.addEventListener('click', fire);
69: 
70:   function fire() {
71:     // Ensure audio context is running (required after user gesture)
72:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
73:     shootSound();
74:     projectiles.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2, y: ship.y, r: 4, speed: 8 });
75:   }
76: 
77:   const projectiles = [];
78:   const meteors = [];
79:   let score = 0;
80:   let gameOver = false;
81: 
82:   // Spawn meteors
83:   function spawnMeteor() {
84:     const radius = 12 + Math.random() * 12;
85:     meteors.push({
86:       x: Math.random() * (width - 2 * radius) + radius,
87:       y: -radius,
88:       r: radius,
89:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2,
90:       color: '#f44',
91:     });
92:   }
93:   setInterval(spawnMeteor, 1000);
94: 
95:   function update() {
96:     if (gameOver) return;
97:     // Move ship
98:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x -= ship.speed;
99:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x += ship.speed;
100:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
101: 
102:     // Update projectiles
103:     for (let i = projectiles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
104:       const p = projectiles[i];
105:       p.y -= p.speed;
106:       if (p.y < 0) projectiles.splice(i, 1);
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Update meteors
110:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const m = meteors[i];
112:       m.y += m.speed;
113:       // Collision with ship (simple AABB vs circle)
114:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.w, h: ship.h };
115:       const distX = Math.abs(m.x - (shipRect.x + shipRect.w / 2));
116:       const distY = Math.abs(m.y - (shipRect.y + shipRect.h / 2));
117:       if (distX > shipRect.w / 2 + m.r || distY > shipRect.h / 2 + m.r) {
118:         // no collision
119:       } else {
120:         gameOver = true;
121:           if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
122:           gameOverSound();
123:         break;
124:       }
125:       // Collision with projectiles
126:       for (let j = projectiles.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
127:         const p = projectiles[j];
128:         const dx = m.x - p.x;
129:         const dy = m.y - p.y;
130:         if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (m.r + p.r) * (m.r + p.r)) {
131:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
132:           projectiles.splice(j, 1);
133:           score++;
134:           explosionSound();
135:           break;
136:         }
137:       }
138:       // Remove if out of bounds
139:       if (m.y - m.r > height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
140:     }
141:   }

143:   function draw() {
144:     // Space background
145:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000020';
146:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
147:     // Stars
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     stars.forEach(s => {
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     });
154:     // Ship (triangle)
155:     ship.draw(ctx);
156:     // Projectiles (glow)
157:     projectiles.forEach(p => {
158:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, p.r);
159:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
160:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
161:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
162:       ctx.beginPath();
163:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
164:       ctx.fill();
165:     });
166:     // Meteors with gradient
167:     meteors.forEach(m => {
168:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x, m.y, 0, m.x, m.y, m.r);
169:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,68,68,0.9)');
170:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,68,68,0)');
171:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
172:       ctx.beginPath();
173:       ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
174:       ctx.fill();
175:     });
176:     // Score
177:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
178:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
179:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
180:     // Game over overlay
181:     if (gameOver) {
182:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
183:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
184:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
185:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
186:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
187:     }
188:   }
189:   }
190: 
191:   function loop() {
192:     if (!gameOver) update();
193:     draw();
194:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
195:   }
196:   loop();
197: })();
